scope: Acoustic computation only; fixed saved and tiled inputs, not natural speech quality validation

hardware.scope: Hardware observed for this experiment; other adapters and driver versions are not validated
hardware.observation: Captured immediately after the timed experiment on the same host; not a utilization measurement

fixed_input_construction: Four source validation NPZ cases (1/2/7/19 tokens); 43/256-token cases tile codes and explicit noise from the 19-token case, retaining its phones, reference embeddings and noise_scale.
no_memory_usage_claim: File and initializer sizes are measured storage bytes; process or GPU peak memory was not measured in this acoustic timing run.
